plain: Card.Metric, Stat, MetricTile, MetricTiles and Blockquote's size prop are deprecated and still work; nothing is removed.

steps.plain: Card.Metric is deprecated and still works; no replacement is planned, so compose a Card with the type roles (caption label, display or title value).
